blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Aseptic Process Simulation, APS (無菌製程模擬)：又稱 Media Fill (培養基充填)，是使用微生物培養基來模擬整個無菌製造流程，以驗證該製程是否能確保產品的無菌性。這是無菌製程驗證的最終展示 (final demonstration)，而非唯一手段。
blocks.en: Aseptic Process Simulation, APS: Also called a media fill, APS uses microbiological growth medium to simulate the entire aseptic manufacturing process in order to demonstrate that the process can assure product sterility. It is the final demonstration of aseptic process validation, not the only means of demonstrating it.

blocks.zh: Contamination Control Strategy, CCS (污染控制策略)：2022年 EU GMP Annex 1 強制要求的整體策略文件，涵蓋對微生物、內毒素/熱原、及外來微粒污染風險的識別、評估、控制與監測。TR22 (2025) 的修訂正是為了支持 CCS 的整體架構。
blocks.en: Contamination Control Strategy, CCS: The overarching strategy document required by EU GMP Annex 1 (2022). It covers the identification, assessment, control and monitoring of the risks of microbial, endotoxin/pyrogen and particulate contamination. The 2025 revision of TR22 was made to support the overall CCS framework.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 APS 想像成醫院的感染管控演習。醫院不會只靠一次消防演練就宣稱「我們永遠不會發生院內感染」。真正的感染管控需要：設施設計、空調過濾、人員培訓、消毒 SOP、環境監測等所有措施的整合。APS 就像年度消防演練 —— 它是所有控制措施的「總驗收」，但不能取代日常的感染管控工作。
blocks.en: Think of APS as a hospital infection-control drill. A hospital would never claim "we will never have a hospital-acquired infection" on the strength of a single fire drill. Real infection control depends on the integration of facility design, HVAC and filtration, staff training, disinfection SOPs, environmental monitoring and more. APS is like the annual drill: it is the "final acceptance" of all the control measures, but it cannot replace day-to-day infection-control work.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 2025 修訂的三大驅動力：
blocks.en: Three drivers of the 2025 revision:

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022)：這是自 2008 年以來最大幅度的修訂，對 APS 提出了更明確、更嚴格的要求，包括 CCS 的強制性框架
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022): This is the most extensive revision since 2008. It sets clearer and stricter expectations for APS, including a mandatory CCS framework

blocks.zh: 全球法規趨同：PIC/S Annex 1 與 EU Annex 1 完全一致，意味著更多國家採用相同標準
blocks.en: Global regulatory convergence: PIC/S Annex 1 is fully aligned with EU Annex 1, meaning more countries are adopting the same standard

blocks.zh: 風險導向思維：從「一刀切」的 APS 設計轉向基於科學評估與風險分析的設計方法
blocks.en: Risk-based thinking: A shift from a "one-size-fits-all" APS design to a design approach based on scientific assessment and risk analysis

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR22 強調 APS 不應被視為驗證無菌製程的「主要手段」？如果不是 APS，那什麼才是？
blocks.en: Why does TR22 stress that APS should not be regarded as the "primary means" of validating an aseptic process? If not APS, what is?

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的發布如何影響了這份技術報告的修訂方向？
blocks.en: How did the publication of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) influence the direction of this technical report's revision?

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose 目的
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose

blocks.zh: 「指引」(Guide) vs.「標準」(Standard)：TR22 明確聲明它是一份指引，不是強制性標準。這是 PDA 技術報告的一貫定位：提供業界最佳實踐的參考，但每家公司需根據自身情況進行調整。
blocks.en: "Guide" vs. "Standard": TR22 states clearly that it is a guidance document, not a mandatory standard. This is the consistent positioning of PDA technical reports: they offer a reference for industry best practice, but each company must adapt it to its own circumstances.

blocks.zh: 無菌製程驗證的完整拼圖：原文列出了完整的驗證要素，APS 只是其中之一：
blocks.en: The complete picture of aseptic process validation: The original text lists the full set of validation elements, of which APS is only one:

blocks.zh: Process Design (製程設計)
blocks.en: Process Design

blocks.zh: Equipment Qualification (設備確效)
blocks.en: Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: Pharmaceutical Quality System (藥品品質系統)
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Quality System

blocks.zh: Process Controls (製程管控)
blocks.en: Process Controls

blocks.zh: Process Monitoring & Data Evaluation (製程監測與數據評估)
blocks.en: Process Monitoring & Data Evaluation

blocks.zh: Personnel Training (人員培訓)
blocks.en: Personnel Training

blocks.zh: APS (無菌製程模擬) — 最終展示
blocks.en: APS (Aseptic Process Simulation) - the final demonstration

blocks.zh: APS 就像學生的期末考試。考試成績好不等於你真的學好了；真正的學習來自平時的聽課、作業、實驗、討論。同理，APS 通過不代表無菌製程就沒問題 —— 真正的保證來自日常的設計、管控、培訓和監測。反過來說，如果期末考不及格（APS 失敗），那顯然日常學習（製程管控）出了嚴重問題。
blocks.en: APS is like a student's final exam. A good exam result does not prove you have really learned the material; real learning comes from attending lectures, doing homework and experiments, and taking part in discussions. Likewise, passing an APS does not mean the aseptic process is free of problems; the real assurance comes from day-to-day design, controls, training and monitoring. Conversely, if the final exam is failed (APS failure), it is obvious that something is seriously wrong with the day-to-day learning (process controls).

blocks.zh: CDMO 特別注意：作為委託開發暨製造組織，您可能面對來自不同國家客戶的不同法規要求。TR22 的這段聲明暗示：
blocks.en: Special note for CDMOs: As a contract development and manufacturing organization, you may face different regulatory requirements from customers in different countries. This statement in TR22 implies that:

blocks.zh: 不能只依賴一份 APS protocol 打天下 — 需要考慮客戶所在市場的特定要求
blocks.en: You cannot rely on a single APS protocol for every case; the specific requirements of the customer's target market must be considered

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA、EU/PIC/S、日本 PMDA、中國 NMPA 等各有細微差異
blocks.en: US FDA, EU/PIC/S, Japan PMDA, China NMPA and others each have subtle differences

blocks.zh: 風險導向的 APS 設計能提供更靈活的框架來適應不同法規需求
blocks.en: A risk-based APS design provides a more flexible framework for adapting to different regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 假設您的 CDMO 同時為美國和歐盟市場生產無菌注射劑。美國 FDA Guidance (2004) 與 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 在 APS 設計上有些差異（例如充填數量、頻率要求）。您的 APS protocol 應如何設計，才能同時滿足兩個市場的要求？答案通常是：採用較嚴格的要求作為基準，並用風險評估來合理化設計決策。
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO manufactures sterile injectables for both the US and EU markets. The US FDA Guidance (2004) and EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) differ somewhat in APS design (for example, number of units filled and frequency requirements). How should your APS protocol be designed to satisfy both markets? The answer is usually to adopt the stricter requirement as the baseline and use risk assessment to justify design decisions.

blocks.zh: 原文中的 "final demonstration of the sum of the controls" 這句話的含義是什麼？為什麼 APS 是「總和」而非「替代」？
blocks.en: What does the phrase "final demonstration of the sum of the controls" in the original text mean? Why is APS the "sum" of the controls rather than a "substitute" for them?

blocks.zh: 如果一家公司的 APS 連續三次全數通過（零污染），但環境監測數據顯示出不良趨勢，這代表什麼？應該如何處理？
blocks.en: If a company's APS passes three times in a row with zero contaminated units, but environmental monitoring data show an adverse trend, what does that mean? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 1.1 Scope 範圍
blocks.en: 1.1 Scope

blocks.zh: 適用範圍 (In Scope)：
blocks.en: In Scope:

blocks.zh: 藥品與生物製藥的無菌配方及充填活動
blocks.en: Aseptic formulation and filling activities for pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical products

blocks.zh: 人用及動物用產品
blocks.en: Human and veterinary products

blocks.zh: 可延伸應用至無菌醫療器材與體外診斷產品
blocks.en: May be extended to sterile medical devices and in vitro diagnostic products

blocks.zh: 不適用範圍 (Out of Scope)：
blocks.en: Out of Scope:

blocks.zh: 無菌原料藥 (sterile bulk materials) 的製備
blocks.en: Preparation of sterile bulk materials

blocks.zh: 生技製程中的菌種培養與進料 (inoculums and feed materials)
blocks.en: Inoculums and feed materials in biotechnology processes

blocks.zh: 交叉參考：原文特別推薦讀者參閱 PDA Points to Consider No. 1: Aseptic Processing (Revised 2023)。這份文件涵蓋了無菌製程的更廣泛議題，而 TR22 則專注於 APS 這個特定環節。兩份文件互為補充，在實務上應一起參考。
blocks.en: Cross-reference: The original text specifically recommends that readers consult PDA Points to Consider No. 1: Aseptic Processing (Revised 2023). That document covers the broader topics of aseptic processing, while TR22 focuses on the specific element of APS. The two documents complement each other and should be used together in practice.

blocks.zh: 想像一條河流：上游（原料藥製備、菌種培養）的水質當然重要，但 TR22 的焦點是下游的充填站 — 也就是把已經準備好的無菌產品裝入容器並密封的那段製程。上游的管控另有其他指引負責。
blocks.en: Imagine a river. The water quality upstream (bulk drug substance preparation, inoculum culture) certainly matters, but TR22 focuses on the filling station downstream, that is, the part of the process in which the already prepared sterile product is filled into containers and sealed. Upstream controls are covered by other guidance.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR22 將無菌原料藥的製備排除在範圍之外？這類操作的 APS 會由哪些其他文件來指導？
blocks.en: Why does TR22 exclude the preparation of sterile bulk materials from its scope? Which other documents guide APS for such operations?

blocks.zh: 一家同時生產無菌注射劑和無菌醫療器材的工廠，是否可以用相同的 APS 方法論來驗證兩條產線？
blocks.en: A site that manufactures both sterile injectables and sterile medical devices: can it use the same APS methodology to validate both lines?

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary 術語表
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary

blocks.zh: Environmental Monitoring Terms 環境監測相關
blocks.en: Environmental Monitoring Terms

blocks.zh: Microbiology Terms 微生物學相關
blocks.en: Microbiology Terms

blocks.zh: Aseptic Processing Terms 無菌製程相關
blocks.en: Aseptic Processing Terms

blocks.zh: Process & Quality Terms 製程與品質相關
blocks.en: Process & Quality Terms

blocks.zh: Barrier & Containment Systems 屏障與隔離系統
blocks.en: Barrier & Containment Systems

blocks.en: Interventions

blocks.zh: 這份術語表涵蓋了 TR22 全文使用的關鍵定義。以下將最重要的術語分組解析，幫助您建立系統性的理解框架。
blocks.en: This glossary covers the key definitions used throughout TR22. The most important terms are analyzed below by group to help you build a systematic framework of understanding.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Alert vs. Action Limits
blocks.en: Key Notes: Alert vs. Action Limits

blocks.zh: Alert Level (警戒限度) 與 Action Limit (行動限度) 是環境監測的兩道防線：
blocks.en: Alert Level and Action Limit are the two lines of defense in environmental monitoring:

blocks.zh: Alert Level：「黃燈」— 提示可能偏離正常狀態，需要跟進調查但不一定要停產
blocks.en: Alert Level: the "yellow light". It signals a possible departure from the normal state and calls for follow-up investigation, but not necessarily a production stop

blocks.zh: Action Limit：「紅燈」— 必須立即啟動調查和矯正行動
blocks.en: Action Limit: the "red light". An investigation and corrective action must be started immediately

blocks.zh: 這兩個限度應基於歷史趨勢數據和確效數據來設定，並定期檢討。
blocks.en: These limits should be set on the basis of historical trend data and validation data, and reviewed periodically.

blocks.zh: APS 的完整定義解析
blocks.en: Full Definition of APS

blocks.zh: 注意 APS 的定義中提到模擬範圍包含：
blocks.en: Note that the definition of APS says the simulation covers:

blocks.zh: Equipment assembly (設備組裝)
blocks.en: Equipment assembly

blocks.zh: Formulation (配方調配)
blocks.en: Formulation

blocks.zh: Filling (充填)
blocks.en: Filling

blocks.zh: Lyophilization (凍乾) — 如適用
blocks.en: Lyophilization - if applicable

blocks.zh: Sealing (密封)
blocks.en: Sealing

blocks.zh: 關鍵詞是「entire aseptic manufacturing process」— 不是只模擬充填這一步，而是模擬所有無菌操作環節。
blocks.en: The key phrase is "entire aseptic manufacturing process": the simulation is not limited to the filling step but covers every aseptic operation.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Isolator 的開放與封閉
blocks.en: Analogy: Open and Closed Isolators

blocks.zh: 把 Isolator (隔離器) 想像成兩種太空站：
blocks.en: Think of an isolator as two kinds of space station:

blocks.zh: Closed Isolator (封閉式)：就像國際太空站的對接艙 — 物料透過密封接口傳入傳出，內部完全不與外界接觸
blocks.en: Closed Isolator: like the docking module of the International Space Station. Materials are transferred in and out through sealed connections, and the interior never comes into contact with the outside environment

blocks.zh: Open Isolator (開放式)：就像有氣閘門的太空站 — 設計了特殊的開口讓物料進出，但透過正壓氣流確保外界空氣不會倒灌進來
blocks.en: Open Isolator: like a space station with an airlock. Special openings are designed for material entry and exit, but positive-pressure airflow ensures that outside air cannot flow back in

blocks.zh: 兩種設計都能提供 Grade A/ISO 5 的環境，但對 APS 設計的挑戰不同 — 開放式因為有物料進出口，需要更多關注開口處的污染風險。
blocks.en: Both designs can provide a Grade A/ISO 5 environment, but they pose different challenges for APS design. Because an open isolator has material entry and exit ports, more attention must be paid to the contamination risk at the openings.

blocks.zh: CCS 的核心地位
blocks.en: The Central Role of the CCS

blocks.zh: Contamination Control Strategy (污染控制策略) 是 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 引入的最重要概念之一。其定義涵蓋了三大污染類型的識別、評估、控制與監測：
blocks.en: Contamination Control Strategy is one of the most important concepts introduced by EU GMP Annex 1 (2022). Its definition covers the identification, assessment, control and monitoring of three types of contamination:

blocks.zh: Microorganisms (微生物)
blocks.en: Microorganisms

blocks.zh: Pyrogens/Endotoxins (熱原/內毒素)
blocks.en: Pyrogens/Endotoxins

blocks.zh: Foreign Particulates (外來微粒)
blocks.en: Foreign Particulates

blocks.zh: APS 是 CCS 架構中的一個關鍵驗證工具，但不是 CCS 的全部。
blocks.en: APS is a key validation tool within the CCS framework, but it is not the whole of the CCS.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Bracket 策略
blocks.en: Analogy: The Bracketing Strategy

blocks.zh: Bracket (包夾法/極端值驗證) 就像測試一座橋的承重能力：如果最輕的小客車和最重的貨車都能安全通過，那中間重量的車輛也沒問題。在 APS 中，如果最小和最大的容器規格都能通過，中間規格就不需要逐一測試。這是一種聰明的風險導向策略，可以顯著減少 APS 的執行次數。
blocks.en: Bracketing is like testing the load capacity of a bridge: if both the lightest passenger car and the heaviest truck can cross safely, vehicles of intermediate weight will be fine too. In APS, if both the smallest and the largest container formats pass, the intermediate formats do not need to be tested one by one. This is a smart risk-based strategy that can significantly reduce the number of APS runs.

blocks.zh: IREM 模型簡介
blocks.en: Introduction to the IREM Model

blocks.zh: Intervention Risk Evaluation & Management Model (介入風險評估與管理模型) 是 TR22 提出的系統性方法，用於：
blocks.en: The Intervention Risk Evaluation & Management (IREM) Model is a systematic approach proposed in TR22 for:

blocks.zh: 識別所有無菌製程中的介入操作
blocks.en: Identifying all interventions in the aseptic process

blocks.zh: 評估每個介入操作對無菌性的風險等級
blocks.en: Assessing the risk level each intervention poses to sterility

blocks.zh: 排定優先順序並決定哪些必須在 APS 中模擬
blocks.en: Prioritizing them and deciding which must be simulated in the APS

blocks.zh: 這個模型將在後續章節（第 15 章）詳細展開。
blocks.en: This model is developed in detail in a later section (Section 15).

blocks.zh: 在 APS 中，為什麼需要同時考慮 Inherent Intervention 和 Corrective Intervention？如果只模擬 Inherent Intervention 會遺漏什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why must an APS consider both Inherent Interventions and Corrective Interventions? What risks would be missed if only Inherent Interventions were simulated?

blocks.zh: Alert Level 和 Action Limit 的設定依據是什麼？為什麼不能直接套用法規中的限度值？
blocks.en: What is the basis for setting Alert Levels and Action Limits? Why can the limit values in regulations not simply be applied directly?

blocks.zh: 「封閉式隔離器」和「開放式隔離器」在 APS 設計上會有什麼不同的考量？
blocks.en: What different considerations apply to APS design for closed isolators and open isolators?

blocks.zh: Campaign manufacturing (連續生產) 對 APS 模擬的持續時間有什麼影響？
blocks.en: How does campaign manufacturing affect the duration of the APS simulation?

blocks.zh: 假設您正在建立新廠的 APS 方案。術語表中的每個定義都對應了一個您需要在 APS protocol 中明確定義的要素。建議在撰寫 APS 協議時，將這些術語作為「定義」章節的基礎，確保團隊內部對所有關鍵概念有一致的理解。特別注意：不同客戶可能對同一個術語有不同的解讀，因此在 protocol 中明確定義可以避免後續爭議。
blocks.en: Suppose you are building an APS program for a new facility. Each definition in the glossary corresponds to an element that you need to define explicitly in your APS protocol. It is recommended to use these terms as the basis of the "Definitions" section when writing the APS protocol, so that the team shares a consistent understanding of all key concepts. Note in particular that different customers may interpret the same term differently, so defining it explicitly in the protocol avoids later disputes.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Intervention 分類體系
blocks.en: Key Notes: Classification of Interventions

blocks.zh: 介入操作 (Intervention) 的分類是 APS 設計的核心議題之一：
blocks.en: The classification of interventions is one of the core issues in APS design:

blocks.zh: 在設計 APS 時，必須確保所有類型的介入操作都被納入模擬中。後續章節會介紹 IREM 模型來系統性地評估介入風險。
blocks.en: When designing an APS, you must ensure that all types of interventions are included in the simulation. Later sections introduce the IREM model for systematically assessing intervention risk.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: TR22 (2025) 定位：這是一份指引而非強制標準，旨在反映 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 後的最新業界思維，並強調風險導向的 APS 設計方法
blocks.en: Positioning of TR22 (2025): It is a guidance document rather than a mandatory standard. It is intended to reflect current industry thinking after EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) and emphasizes a risk-based approach to APS design

blocks.zh: APS 的角色：APS 是無菌製程驗證的「最終展示」，但不能取代製程設計、設備確效、品質系統、製程管控、監測和人員培訓等基礎要素
blocks.en: Role of APS: APS is the "final demonstration" of aseptic process validation, but it cannot replace foundational elements such as process design, equipment qualification, the quality system, process controls, monitoring and personnel training

blocks.zh: CCS 整合：APS 應納入製造場所整體污染控制策略 (CCS) 的框架中，而非獨立運作
blocks.en: CCS integration: APS should be incorporated into the site's overall Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) framework rather than operate independently

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：聚焦於藥品/生物製藥的無菌配方與充填活動，不涵蓋無菌原料藥製備或生技菌種培養
blocks.en: Scope: Focused on aseptic formulation and filling activities for pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical products; it does not cover the preparation of sterile bulk materials or inoculum culture in biotechnology

blocks.zh: Intervention 分類：固有介入 (Inherent)、矯正介入 (Corrective)、關鍵介入 (Critical) 的三層分類體系是 APS 設計的基礎
blocks.en: Intervention classification: The three-tier classification of Inherent, Corrective and Critical interventions is the foundation of APS design

blocks.zh: 術語一致性：跨團隊、跨客戶的術語一致理解是成功執行 APS 的前提條件
blocks.en: Terminology consistency: A consistent understanding of terms across teams and customers is a prerequisite for successful APS execution
